title: 72-hour emergency kit
tldr: Start with at least three days of safe water, ready-to-eat food, essential medicines, lighting and communication supplies. Include one gallon of water per person per day as a starting point, and account for pets, heat, medical needs and accessibility.
steps: Gather usable supplies before buying duplicates.
Choose safe water, shelf-stable food, a can opener, light, radio, batteries and phone charging.
Add medication arrangements, eyeglasses, infant needs, pet supplies, hygiene and accessible equipment.
Label dates, rotate food and water as instructed and check supplies routinely.
next: Build longer-duration supplies as space and budget allow. Keep an evacuation bag separate enough to carry.
watch: A standard checklist is only a starting point; three days may not cover a prolonged disruption.
shopping: Shelf-stable food and manual can opener
Pet and infant supplies as needed
